name: tp-cloud
description: Snowball — plataforma de monitoreo de cadena de frío (ITBA Cloud, Entrega 2)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @snowball/shared && npm run build -w @snowball/alert-processor && npm run build -w @snowball/simulator && npm run build -w @snowball/api && npm run build -w @snowball/telemetry-export && npm run build -w @snowball/dashboard
scripts.bundle: npm run build -w @snowball/shared && npm run bundle -w @snowball/alert-processor && npm run zip -w @snowball/alert-processor && npm run bundle:no-signal -w @snowball/alert-processor && npm run zip:no-signal -w @snowball/alert-processor && npm run bundle -w @snowball/api && npm run bundle -w @snowball/telemetry-export && npm run zip -w @snowball/telemetry-export
